meta.title: Hotels and guest houses: the front desk and the folio · Clafina
meta.description: A front desk, a room rack, housekeeping on the phone and a folio that takes charges from every till. The Accommodation pack for Clafina.

hero.title: Every guest, every room and every folio, in one place.
hero.lede: The front desk knows which rooms are ready, the restaurant charges to the room, and the night audit closes the day while you sleep.

business.name: Marina Court Hotel
business.about: A 24-room hotel with a restaurant and a bar, taking guests on holiday and on business.

dayTitle: A day at Marina Court Hotel

moments.title: Closing yesterday
moments.problem: Before the new day starts, every guest in the house needs last night on their folio.
moments.handles: The night audit runs by itself after the hotel's audit time. It posts one room night to each guest in the house, marks arrivals who never came as no-shows with the fee rule, counts the folios still owing and closes the day.

moments.title: Which room first?
moments.problem: Blessing has five rooms to clean, and a guest is coming early to one of them.
moments.handles: Her phone lists each room's tasks for the day. Room 108 is at the top, marked as an early-arrival priority because Mr Okafor arrives at 11:00.

moments.title: Is the room ready yet?
moments.problem: The front desk keeps phoning upstairs to ask.
moments.handles: Rooms go from dirty to clean to inspected. Each change Blessing or the inspector makes reaches the desk at once, with no refresh.

moments.title: A guest arrives early
moments.problem: Mr Okafor is at the desk three hours before check-in, and room 108 is still being cleaned.
moments.handles: Check-in only puts a guest into an inspected room, or a clean one if you allow it. The desk sees that 109 is inspected and free tonight, and moves him there.

moments.title: Lunch on the room
moments.problem: Mrs Okon has lunch in the restaurant and asks for it to go on her room.
moments.handles: The restaurant till posts the bill by room number to her open folio, once only. It is there before she is back upstairs.

moments.title: The company pays the rooms, not the bar
moments.problem: Ikom Cocoa Growers is paying for three rooms this week, but not the drinks.
moments.handles: The folio names the company and what it covers, room nights or everything. A charge can be moved to the company bill, and the company's share becomes one customer invoice. The guest pays her own lunch, bar and laundry.

moments.title: A busy weekend is coming
moments.problem: A trade fair in town at the end of November will fill the hotel.
moments.handles: The manager adds a special date with a higher price and a two-night minimum stay. Try a price shows each step from the base rate to the night's price.

moments.title: A guest asks to move rooms
moments.problem: Mrs Bassey would like a quieter room for her last two nights.
moments.handles: The stay is dragged on the room rack. A move onto a room already held for those nights is refused, so no room is ever sold twice.

words.meaning: The person staying. The pack uses Guest in place of customer.
A guest's nights in a room, from arrival to departure.
Today's arrivals, guests in the house and departures, with check-in, check-out and moves.
Every room by night, with who holds it.
A guest's running bill. Lines are never changed, only corrected by a new line.
A bill from any till in the hotel, posted to the guest's folio.
A price beside the base rate, such as bed and breakfast or non-refundable.
A season repeats each year. A special date sets a price, a minimum stay or closes the night.
The close of the hotel's day: room nights posted and no-shows marked.
A room off sale, with a reason, that the desk cannot book.

switchesTitle: What the Accommodation pack switches on

switchesOn.text: A front desk with arrivals, guests in the house and departures, check-in, check-out and moves
A room rack of every room by night, which refuses a move onto a room already held
Housekeeping with dirty, clean, inspected and out of order, live on the desk and the phone
Folios with service charge, VAT and a second consumption tax, by the place's settings
Charge to room from any till in the hotel, once only
Split bills, and a company's share as one customer invoice
Rate plans, seasons that repeat each year, weekend prices and special dates
One count of rooms left for every place you sell, with Stop to close a night
A night audit that runs by itself, or by hand
Deposits, cancellation and no-show fees, and a waiting list from the booking engine
Live connections to outside booking sites
Group bookings with a rooming list
A public booking page for rooms

sharesTitle: What it shares with the rest of Clafina

shares.text: Rooms, room types and stays are the booking engine's, on one availability grid with no double booking.
The restaurant and bar tills charge to the room.
A company's share of a stay becomes one customer invoice.
Guests and companies are customers, with their history.
Cash, card, transfer, wallet and deposits taken on the folio, and refunds.
Document settings for each place, on every folio and invoice.

modulesTitle: The parts of Clafina a hotel uses

faq.q: Is it for guest houses and short-lets too?
faq.a: Yes. Hotels, guest houses and short-lets are each a kind of place the pack sets up.

faq.q: Can a room be sold twice?
faq.a: No. Rooms and stays sit on the booking engine's one availability grid, and a move onto a room already held is refused.

faq.q: How does the restaurant bill a guest?
faq.a: The till posts the bill by room number to the guest's open folio, once only.

faq.q: Can a company pay for the room but not the bar?
faq.a: Yes. The folio names what the company covers, a charge can be moved to it, and its share becomes one invoice.

faq.q: What does the night audit do?
faq.a: It posts a room night to each guest in the house, marks no-shows with the fee rule, counts folios still owing and closes the day.

faq.q: Can we connect the booking sites we sell on?
faq.a: Yes. Each connection uses your own account on that site, and every site sees the same count of rooms left.

cta.title: Open your front desk today.
cta.body: Start free, switch on the Accommodation pack at your hotel, and your rooms read as clean until housekeeping says otherwise.
